# Review — cid-tiradas-134-136 (vv. 2968–3059, tiradas 134–136)

Checked: every unit's `t`/`l`/`i`/`n` (37 units) against the pinned packet and conventions.md; the scan, PDF pp. 315–321
(printed 311–317), read at zoom 1.4, with clips at zoom 3–7 of the margin labels and lines 3007–3013 on p. 318, the
footnotes to 2988, 2994 and 3004 (*Alvar Díaz*, italic í) on p. 317, the footnote to 3047 (*San Víctor*, *allí*) and
v. 3045 (*si* unaccented) on p. 320. All three rubrics (134, 135, 136) and every Pidal footnote quoted in the notes
(2972, 2982, 2988, 2994, 2997, 3002, 3004, 3005, 3008, 3011, 3026, 3028, 3030, 3041, 3042, 3047, 3049, 3058-59, the last
running on to p. 321) were compared with the notes letter by letter. Cross-references checked in the published parts:
v. 2942 *abiltados*, 2959 *Entre yo e mio Çid*, 2960 *sín*, 2963 note (*cort*), *nasco* formula in 132-133, *varones* in
131. House renderings checked against conventions.md (Ruy Díaz, Diego and Fernando, Count García, Saint Isidore, "my
Çid" in `i`, the *en buen ora* formula, *dar derecho*, *Merçed* "Mercy, O king", *sí … salve el Criador*, Asur
González, Count Don Gonzalo, Tajo, Ximena).

The `t` fields joined by "\n" equal the packet's 94 verses in order (3009b and 3014b included); no `t` was changed;
every `l` has as many lines as its `t`; the longest unit is 4 lines (verified by script after editing). Both files
parse.

## Pass 1: units.json

1. 3058–3059 · n · error. The English of Pidal's note made "the American critic Adam" one person: *siguen al crítico
   americano Adam y Bertoni* means "Adam and Bertoni follow the American critic" (Bello). Fixed. Also Hinard's
   *avertis* was given as "roused"; now "informed".
2. 3009b · n · weak. The numbering note said the footnotes "would fit if the unnumbered line were the Álvar Díaz line
   instead". That fits the footnote 3008 but not 3011 (enbair would still be 3012). On the scan (p. 318, zoom 3) the only
   count that fits every footnote (3008 Asur González, 3011 enbair, 3026 biltar) and the labels 3015, 3020, 3025
   (printed 3250) is: neither wholly italic line numbered — Pidal's practice with his restored lines elsewhere (755b,
   875b–e, 896b, 934b in the published parts) — and the label 3010 printed one line too high (it belongs to *e con
   ellos*). The note now says this, keeps the pinned numbers, and calls the question open.
3. 3013–3014b · n · weak. Added that by that count the 3014b line is Pidal's 3014.
4. 3009b · n · weak. Per Ansuórez was stated to be Count Pedro Ansúrez "by Pidal's note"; the note names Pedro Ansúrez
   only as Gonzalo's brother and does not mention this line. Now "presumably …, though the note does not tie him to this
   line".
5. 3009b–3012 · i · weak. *e[n]bair le cuydan* "they mean to bear down on" was weaker than Pidal's 'atropellar,
   maltratar'; now "they mean to trample on my Çid".
6. 3042 · n · style. "which this note glosses 'así me salve Dios' … taking sín as sí + me": Pidal paraphrases, he does
   not analyse *sín*. Now "its así me supports reading sín as sí + me".
7. 2983–2984 · i · style. "they were all minding it": *all* not in the text. Removed.
8. 2993–2994 · n · style. "he = he (I have)" → "he, 'I have' (= tengo), aver as a full verb".

Rulings on the drafter's points, no change:
- **sín salve Dios (2990, 3042)** — the print has *sín* (acute) both times. Pidal's note to 3042 ('me pesa, así me
  salve Dios', checked on the scan) supports sí + me. Kept, as said in both notes. The published 2960 note (uncertain,
  "no note from Pidal") could now cite 3042; for the owner.
- **sí fago (3042)** — `l` "yes I-do", `i` "It grieves me indeed" follows Pidal's *verbo vicario* paraphrase. Right.
- **2983 penssando** — "minding it", subject unstated, marked less certain. Right (one word trimmed, item 7).
- **3023 que assí an tal señor** — "as befits men who have such a lord" leans a little beyond the words, but the note
  gives the literal 'who thus have such a lord' and says the turn is uncertain. Kept.
- **2993 irâ** — ir + a, infinitive governed by *quisiesse*. Right; the glosser had it as a 3rd sg. future (Pass 2).
- **3014 èl** — grave as printed (p. 318); "he who". Right.
- **3053–54 [va]** — one *va* governing both infinitives; the italic *va* and final *r*'s confirmed on p. 320. Right.
- **3058–59 acordados** — Pidal's 'preparados' followed, the other readings reported. Right (translation of the note
  fixed, item 1).
- **Names** — Anrric/Arric "Enrique", Remond, Fróila (Pidal's Fruela), Birbón, Oca, Grañón left without historical
  identification; the emperor of 3003 left unnamed. Right under the sole-source rule (the introduction pages are not
  among the allowed aids). Gonzalo Ansúrez in `i` with the house "Count Don Gonzalo" in the note: kept.
- **Margin 3250** for 3025 — confirmed on p. 318.
- **Footnote quotations** — all exact (inner quotes converted to double as in earlier parts). The 2988 note prints
  *assi* unaccented, the 2972 note's second *espacio* without cedilla, the 3041 note *la mano* singular, the 3004 note
  *Alvar Díaz* (italic í confirmed at zoom 7), the 3047 note *San Víctor*: all as the notes say. *allí* in the 3047 note
  cannot be told from *alli* at the scan's resolution; left as quoted.
- **Rubrics** 134, 135, 136 exact.
- **Grammar labels** — Dizidle, nasco, adóbes, véngam, éstol, do, Saludádmelos, aya, abino, Espidiós, es tornado,
  detiene, enbía, fazie, f[o]ssen, viniesse, toviesse, ivan penssando, falliessen, avié, va pesando, verná, quite, feré,
  darlêdes, quisiesse, irâ, vi[d]ieron, es a fer, siemprel, conssejó, Llegava, querien, sabet, allís açertó, aduxieron,
  e[n]bair, cuydan, era llegado, se tarda, venido es, adelantel, besasse, sopiesse, serie, [od]ió, plógol, iva reçebir,
  aguisado, an, ovo, firiós, biltar se quiere, [vido], tardó, avría, saludar nos hemos, se ondre, mande, besóle,
  saludó, Omíllom, salve, bésavos, pese, fago, tornada da, quiso, Penssad de, posaré, llegarán, Terné, plazme, posa[r],
  Mandó fazer, a (= ha), velar, f[o]ron: all right.
- **Remembered translation** — none found.

## Pass 2: gloss.json

1. irâ · error. Glossed as 'goes/will go to (ira 3rd sg.)' — there is no future here; the unit reads the infinitive *ir*
   + *a*, governed by *quisiesse*. Rewritten.
2. espaçio · error. 'leisure, time, room … let there be leisure among them; sense a little uncertain' against Pidal's
   note to 2972 ('solaz, consuelo'; 'alégrense') and the unit. Rewritten from the note.
3. enbair · error. 'to confound, get the better of, deceive; sense a little uncertain' against Pidal's note ('atropellar,
   maltratar') and the unit. Rewritten.
4. __broaden__ assí · weak. 'as … as … the sense is approximate': Pidal's note to 2988 gives the sense ('tantos parientes
   cuantos son'). Rewritten with it.
5. __broaden__ aya · weak. Example 'let there be leisure among them', against the unit. Now 'comfort/solace'.
6. penssando · weak. 'thinking it over' against the unit's 'minding, seeing to'; lemma spelled *pensar*. Now *penssar*,
   with the uncertainty.
7. sabidores · weak. 'men of knowledge' missed Pidal's note to 3005 ('peritos en derecho'). Added.
8. èl · weak. 'grave accent marking the editor's reading' is an invented explanation. Now "printed èl with a grave
   accent".
9. garçía · weak. 'a count named in the poem' — the house and the glossary's *garcía* identify him (Garci Ordóñez).
   Made consistent.
10. detiene · weak. Example 'nothing holds him back': *lo* is the matter, not the king. Now 'he lets nothing delay it'.
11. açertó, allís · weak. Glossed as plain *açertar* + an 'ethic' *se*; it is the reflexive *açertarse* 'to be present'
    (the unit's reading). Both rewritten.
12. __broaden__ acordados · weak (added). The known entry ('prudent', 'agreed') does not cover 'ready, prepared'
    (Pidal's note to 3058-59).
13. __broaden__ varones · weak (added). 'man, male' does not cover *varones castellanos* 'Castilian lords'.
14. __broaden__ fago · weak (added). The vicarious *fazer* of *sí fago* (Pidal's note to 3042).
15. __broaden__ sín · style (added). The known entry says Pidal gives no note; his note to 3042 now supports the reading.
16. __broaden__ saludó · style (added). 'he greeted' — Pidal's note to 3030: the greeting is a kiss.
17. adóbes · style. 'modern adobar means to marinate, repair' and '= que se apreste' dropped; now = se adobe, se
    prepare; the se cut to s said.
18. gallizianos · style. Lemma given as the plural and 'the modern -zianos form does not exist'; now *galliziano*, as the
    known *gallizanos* entry.
19. falliessen · style. 'modern fallar and fallir differ in sense' dropped.
20. darlêdes · style. 'ending -edes' → the auxiliary *(h)edes*; example 'do right by him', as the unit and the house.
21. fróila · style. Pidal's spelling Fruela named as the source of '= Fruela'.
22. ansuórez · style. Example *Gonçalo* (not in the text) → *Gonçal[v]o*; Pidal's forms named.
23. biltar · style. 'modern envilecer is the harsher …' (not from Pidal) → Pidal 'humillar', cf. abiltar.
24. omíllom · style. 'greet' added (house *omillarse* "bow (to), greet").

The broadens of *da*, *es*, *tierra*, *velar*, *nos*, *sí*, *aqueste*, *toviesse*, *fo* are needed and correct. Every
broaden begins with the known entry exactly as in cid-glossary.json + " · " (verified by script, 16 now). gloss.json
parses; its keys equal the 54 novel-form tokens plus `__broaden__`. The rest of the entries (dizidle, siet, véngam,
éstol, saludádmelos, abino, suyo, portogaleses, castellanos, fazie, quite, siemprel, buscó, conssejó, querien, anrric,
remond, enperador, birbón, crespo, grañón, oca, aduxieron, tarda, adelantel, besasse, firiós, duele, ondre, ámen, arric,
dueña, posaré, serván, vigilia, santidad) were checked against the form, the units and Pidal's notes and found right.

## Refused

- 3023 `i` "as befits men who have such a lord": an interpretation, but flagged as uncertain in the note with the
  literal sense beside it. Kept.
- 3005 `i` "men learned in the law" for *sabidores*: Pidal's own gloss; not an addition. Kept.
- 2968 `l` "Tell-him to-the Campeador": the doubled dative is the point of the `l`. Kept.
- 2977 `l` *pora León* "for León": *pora* 'toward, for' (glossary); `i` has "to". Kept.
- *Remond* '= Ramón, Raimundo' in the glossary: a name equivalent, not a historical identification (as Anrric =
  Enrique). Kept.
- No broaden for *cuydan* ('expect' covers 'intend'), *tornada* ('turn, return' covers *tornada da*), *aguisado*
  ('ready, prepared'), *mandó* ('held, governed' covers *Oca mandó*), *ha* ('there are' already listed), *a* (= ha
  already listed).

## Left uncertain

- Numbering at 3007–3015: pinned labels kept (3009b, 3014b); the count from Pidal's footnotes (both italic lines
  unnumbered, label 3010 one line high) stated in the notes as the alternative. For the owner.
- *penssando* (2983), *que assí an tal señor* (3023): marked uncertain in the notes.
- Extent of Pidal's italic in *Bi[rbó]n*, *Fr[ó]ila* (establishing record).
